training_bank: rsi_independent_first_touch_bank_v1, 16 independent courses, three audited counterfactual arms each
inputs: Nine pre-contact frame-30 gait/ball features from the frozen actor action trace; never first-contact outcomes or future frames
reward: If minimum pelvis <0.65 m: -10. If no contact: -3. If any non-foot contact: -2. Otherwise: 2 + min(max(dx60,0),2) - 0.8*abs(dy60) - 0.5*min(abs(dy60)/max(dx60,0.01),5), with -1 penalty for dx60<=0.
training_method: Per-fold feature mean/std from training eight only, std floor 0.1; Euclidean three nearest neighbors, weight=1/(0.1+distance), shrink each action value to its training-fold mean with prior weight 2. Choose highest predicted value, ties prefer parent. No hyperparameter search.
development_validation: Two folds by seed: train all eight even-lane courses on seed 20260953 and evaluate seed 20260954, then reverse. Never use evaluation outcomes to fit that fold.
development_gate: Positive mean held-out reward improvement over parent and best globally fixed training-fold action in both folds, no reduction in clean-foot-only episode count, at least two recovered non-foot/no-contact courses overall, no safety violation. Otherwise reject contextual selector.
